fieldValues.title: Repository and portability carry weight with no guard
fieldValues.summary: Repository and portability each carry 12 corpus statements and zero enforcement checks, while governance carries 13 statements and eleven guards. Same corpus weight, opposite enforcement — which makes this an enforcement gap, not a coverage gap.
evidence: Census cycle two: conformance 77 statements / 17 guards, governance 13 / 11, repository 12 / 0, portability 12 / 0, attribution 3 / 0, versioning 2 / 0 (srs#582).
Versioning and attribution are thin as well as unguarded, which reads as a discovery gap; repository and portability are not thin (srs#582).
Portability is where preserve-over-recognize lives, including the carry-unknown-content rule, and nothing checks it (srs#582).
